name: Velor
summary: Velor combines matte grey powder coated metal with a central panel of matte silver travertine, creating a striking balance between cool structural lines and soft stone texture. The pairing gives the piece a modern, sculptural refinement with a quietly upscale character. The metal part in matt grey powder ,middle with silver travertine marble in matt 50x28x(263-293)
